full_judgment: 12. Admittedly the plaintiff Nos. 2-4 are the daughters of the defendant. Admittedly dower was fixed at Taka 18,000 out of which Taka 5,000 was paid and Taka 13,000 was still lying due. The defendant divorced the plaintiff No. 1 on 9-12-1999 and the suit for dower and maintenance was filed on 5-9-2002 which is within the period of limitation and, as such, the wife is entitled to get a decree for Taka 13,000 as against the dower fixed at the time of marriage. The Court of appeal has rejected the maintenance of plaintiff Nos. 2 and 3 only on the ground that they have crossed the age of 18 years.
